slug: 2024-06-28 Integrated National Data Exchange Systems - Uganda Case Study

facts.fact: DIAL says UGHub is in use today as Uganda's national data exchange system, serving government ministries, departments and agencies as well as private entities.
DIAL says UGHub is used by over 100 government ministries, departments and agencies as well as private entities such as banks, insurers and fintech firms.

note: No figure for exchanges or transactions through UGHub is stated, so no usage fact; as_of is the published date, the document giving no event date.

facts.fact: The DCI brief says Uganda has adopted a centralised architecture with a data exchange platform as the hub connecting different systems and routing their traffic.

note: No count of connected systems or transaction figures stated for Uganda; as_of is the dialogue date of 24 June 2025.

facts.fact: A NITA-U IT professional said on 2026-10-01 that UGHub, a national data integration platform managed by NITA-U, connects NIRA's identity registry to MDAs and private institutions, which verify identities against it in real time.
The same NITA-U speaker said UGHub connects NIRA's registry with more than 150 government ministries, departments and agencies, plus banks and telecoms.

NITA-U's executive director said at the strategic plan launch that the UGHub data integration platform currently connects 37 percent of MDAs, with a target of 73 percent by FY 2029/30; the document gives no count of entities.
NITA-U stated at the 16 June 2026 launch of its strategic plan that UGHub currently connects 37 percent of MDAs, targeted to reach 73 percent by FY 2029/30; no count of entities is given.

systems.system: National ICT Infrastructure Spatial Data Store (NISDS)
systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance with NITA-U

note: Describes a planned geospatial data store for ICT infrastructure, not a government data exchange platform; no fact.

facts.fact: NITA-U's UGHub page states the integration platform is fully operational, connecting government systems for real-time data sharing; dated by the page's 2025-06-19 publication.
The page states UGHub is fully operational and serves over 150 entities, with others onboarding; dated by page publication 2025-06-19.

note: Only GTS meteorological exchange is described, not a government data exchange platform.

facts.fact: NITA-U reports that through the Government interoperability platform, 168 organisations securely exchange information.
NITA-U reports 168 organisations, 70 public institutions and 98 private sector entities, exchange information through the Government interoperability platform.

note: The platform named is regional between EAC states, not a national government exchange.
Single window is a customs system; no data exchange platform stated.

facts.fact: NITA-U's UGhub integration platform is live, enabling data sharing across Uganda government systems and the private sector, per DIAL.
DIAL states 113 public and private entities have been boarded on UGhub.
DIAL reports over 90 million transactions conducted through UGhub, as reported by NITA-U.
